# Golden Compass

> AI-powered investment platform helping Kenyan investors grow wealth through curated pools, with M-Pesa deposits and a conversational AI Navigator.

Golden Compass lets investors top up a wallet via M-Pesa, allocate funds into curated investment pools, monitor portfolio performance, and ask an AI Navigator about strategy and holdings.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): Existing investors sign in to their Golden Compass account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new Golden Compass investor account.
- [Dividend tracking guide](/guides/dividend-tracking): How pool distributions are calculated, paid into your wallet, and tracked over time.
